## 报道摘要 | Report summary

**中文。** 伯尔尼州考古服务机构在 Lötschenpass 调查中发现青铜颈环，按类型归入公元前 2000—1700 年，为史前跨阿尔卑斯山活动增添首饰材料。

**English.** The Bern archaeological service recovered a bronze neck ring at Lötschenpass, typologically dated to 2000–1700 BCE. It adds jewellery to evidence for prehistoric movement through the Alps.

## 日期与既往工作 | Dates and earlier work

**中文。** 颈环于 2026 年 10 月中旬发现，机构公告为 2026-11-18。该山口早有史前材料，不是本周首次证明山口曾被使用；本轮未检得对应论文。

**English.** Recovery was in mid-October 2026; the release is dated 2026-11-18. Prehistoric material was already known at the pass, so this is not its first evidence of use. A corresponding paper was not located in this check.

## 解释边界 | Limits of interpretation

**中文。** 供奉是机构提出的可能解释，尚不能排除遗失等过程。类型学年代不是直接测年；成分、磨损及沉积背景仍待进一步发表，公告未明确项目负责人。

**English.** An offering is the agency’s proposed interpretation; loss and other processes remain unexcluded. Typological dating is not direct dating. Composition, wear and context need fuller publication; the release does not identify a project lead.
